Definition: Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings
BiblicalUsage: When Jabin king of Hazor had heard, he sent to all the kings of the north. The Lord sold Israel into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor, whose captain was Sisera.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Jabins are one line of Canaan's power: the king of Hazor who gathered the north against Joshua, and the king of Hazor who oppressed Israel until Deborah and Barak broke him, and Hazor falls twice because Canaan never learns.
RelatedPeople: Jabin, King of Hazor; Jabin, King of Canaan
